text.p: These are some of the leading stories in Kuwait's press on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- Crown Prince and Prime Minister Sheikh Saad al-Abdulla al-Sabah discusses issues of mutual interest with the United Arab Emirates President Sheikh Zaid bin Sultan al-Nahayan in London. Sheikh Saad left Kuwait in March for medical attention in Britain and the United States after and emergency colon surgery.
- Some 80.5 million shares worth 26 million dinars ($85.2 million) change hands on the Kuwait Stock Exchange on Wednesday.
- Iran's new President Mohammad Khatami says Tehran wants cooperation with all countries, with special emphasis on Gulf countries.
- Kuwait's oil investments in Tunisia amount to $200 million.
- Kuwait plans to build 52,000 houses in 25 years.
- Kuwaiti officials to discuss prospects of environmental cooperation with Germany and Sweden.
- Government being forced to cut expenditure, parliamentarin says.
